verdict.rationale: Kimi is more than a coding agent: it also includes an assistant app and a developer API platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents an ACP protocol for editor connections, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs and OpenAPI specs, but nothing shows Kimi publishing an official MCP server that external agents can connect to. These are adjacent integration surfaces and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
